programme.desc: Adam's Rib: Sick of eating liver and fish for the 11th straight day, Hawkeye hatches a plan to order forty pounds of spare ribs from his favourite restaurant, Adam's Ribs, in Chicago. (S3 Ep11)

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: A Full Rich Day: Hawkeye records a letter to his Dad, detailing the exploits of a Turkish soldier, the loss of a Luxembourg Lieutenant's corpse and tactics to get medical care for a comrade. (S3 Ep12)

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Mad Dogs and Servicemen: Hawkeye notices a dog bite on the back of Radar's hand and advises him to find the dog so they can test it for rabies. Hawkeye treats a young shell-shocked GI. (S3 Ep13)

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Private Charles Lamb: When the 4077th is invited to share an Easter meal with a Greek unit, tender-hearted Radar comes up with a creative way to save the main course. (S3 Ep14)

programme.title: Whatever Happened to...

programme.title: The Fall and Rise of...

programme.title: Brush Strokes
programme.desc: Jacko and Sandra's relationship is now strictly platonic. But, although he is now a 'free man' again, Jacko is thinking more about his life in general than his love life. (S4 Ep4)

programme.title: The Irish R.M.
programme.desc: Oweneen The Sprat: Christmas Eve ends with the Yeates having an unfortunate carriage accident. The family discover one of the injured is a mountain man known as Oweneen the Sprat. (S2 Ep4)

programme.title: Doctor Finlay

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: The First Christmas: The town's Christmas spirit is in question when a family who are Jewish immigrants moves to town. (S3 Ep13)

programme.desc: Indian Agent: Sully is appointed Indian agent to the Cheyenne but grows angry on finding food meant for the tribe diverted and illegal alcohol rampant, and vows to uncover the truth. (S3 Ep14)

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: Wave Of The Future: Mrs. Oleson is convinced that reopening Nellie's Restaurant and Hotel is a good idea, but is she prepared for the competition? (S8 Ep10)

programme.desc: A Christmas They Never Forgot: Snowbound on Christmas Eve, Caroline, Laura and Hester Sue share memories of Christmases past. (S8 Ep11)

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: No Beast So Fierce: James' budding friendship with another boy is jeopardised when he is caught mocking his new friend. (S8 Ep12)

programme.desc: Stone Soup: Laura has a heart-to-heart talk with Willie about responsibility and being a good example to younger students. It's a talk Willie takes seriously and ends up saving Laura's life. (S8 Ep13)

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: The Legacy: A present-day couple buy an antique folding-leaf table with a large 'I' branded on it and are curious to learn about its origins. (S8 Ep14)

programme.desc: Uncle Jed: Charles and Caroline are about to adopt James and Cassandra, until Uncle Jed comes forward demanding custody of the Cooper children. (S8 Ep15)

programme.desc: Second Chance: Hester Sue's ex-husband arrives in Walnut Grove, claiming he has reformed himself by no longer drinking or gambling. But will she give him a second chance? (S8 Ep16)

programme.title: M*A*S*H
